title: Checkered Path to Abyss
description: A surreal painting depicts a black and white checkered floor leading into a misty blue forest of twisted, leafless trees. Dramatic red and black abstract structures tower on the left while a gnarled purple tree and a small leaping figure appear on the right.
prompt: surreal painting of a glowing black and white checkered pathway leading through a misty blue forest of bare twisted trees, dramatic blood red abstract structures and cliffs on the left, gnarled purple tree with a small leaping humanoid figure on the right, dark eerie atmosphere with high contrast lighting, painted in expressive acrylic style
